title: Repair under an expired voluntary warranty
facts_text: I purchased my device 14 months ago and have the receipt. It stopped working yesterday. I have no extended warranty. I am requesting a repair only under the company's voluntary warranty program.
request: Can you arrange that repair free of charge?
base_rule: Under the company's voluntary warranty program, free repairs are available only during the first 12 months after purchase. After 12 months, repairs under this program must be paid for by the customer.

policy_variants.strict: Under the company's voluntary warranty program, free repairs are available only during the first 12 months after purchase. After 12 months, repairs under this program must be paid for by the customer. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: Under the company's voluntary warranty program, free repairs are available only during the first 12 months after purchase. After 12 months, repairs under this program must be paid for by the customer. The only exception is as follows: Provide one free repair when a device stops working within 15 months of purchase, the customer supplies the receipt, and the customer has no extended warranty. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: Under the company's voluntary warranty program, free repairs are available only during the first 12 months after purchase. After 12 months, repairs under this program must be paid for by the customer. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.
